name: Liraglutide
description: A once-daily GLP-1 receptor agonist approved as Victoza for type 2 diabetes and as Saxenda for chronic weight management.

systems.note: GLP-1 receptor agonism driving glucose-dependent insulin secretion.
Weight loss includes a lean-mass component.
